prompts: Production sprite sheet for Distrito Quimera game, pixel art. THREE horizontal rows of FOUR cells each, 12 separate full-body sprites with spacious transparent gutters. Use attached reference images as exact character identity and existing game's squat proportions and shading. All actors face RIGHT, low side-on beat-em-up camera. Row 1: FIRST REFERENCE ACTOR hero Cap, brown hair, red headband, olive fatigues, brown boots, bare of weapons. Four successive grounded poses as he reaches down to pick an item up from the STREET in front of him: slight squat, deeper knee bend extending right hand, FULL crouch with knuckles touching ground about a boot length ahead of his front foot, half rising while bringing the grasping hand in. Keep his boots at a consistent spacing, boots planted, show bent knees and lowered head in deepest pose, hands EMPTY so engine can insert correct item. Row 2: SECOND REFERENCE ACTOR infected soldier in olive helmet, ghoul face, backpack and fatigues. Four distinct recover-from-knockdown poses: lying flat on his side head to the LEFT and boots right, propped on elbow, kneeling on one knee bracing a glove on the street, three-quarter rising onto both feet. Keep exact identity. Row 3: FOURTH REFERENCE ACTOR large green scaly laboratory lizard in torn pale coat, purple trousers, long tail and dorsal spines. KO sequence: struck and reeling, drops to knees, collapsing shoulders on side, fully sprawled flat on side with limp extended tail, each full body anatomically coherent, same actual scale even when horizontal. No ground shadows, ground, labels, dividers, other characters, weapons, effects. Clean hard pixels with warm highlights, sympathetic 16-bit arcade character art and heavy dark edges. Equal columns, all parts completely inside their cells.

4 columns by 5 rows, 20 full-body arcade combat sprite poses on transparent background. In reference, use ONLY the third character (eccentric white-haired scientist wearing round blue goggles, torn white lab coat over dark trousers and brown shoes, green serum flasks) and fourth character (broad muscular green lizard monster with dorsal spikes, torn white coat, purple pants and long thick tail). Keep exact identities, side-on arcade style facing RIGHT, chunky pixel clusters and warm highlights; all limbs and tails wholly inside cells with clear empty space. Each row is a single action progression, identical character scale and common floor within the row. ROW 1 scientist's overhand vial throw: winding arm back with emerald flask, above shoulder, arm thrust forward releasing flask, follow-through. ROW 2 scientist's point-blank chemical smash: holding two amber sample flasks crossed at chest, lifting them overhead, crouching to smash them on the floor, kneeling braced with empty palms. ROW 3 lizard's tail sweep: winds tail backward, twists torso, broad horizontal tail curling in a low sweeping arc toward screen RIGHT past its claws, recovery. ROW 4 lizard's leap: on haunches crouched, feet leaving ground with arms extended in lunge, midair fully stretched horizontally claws first and legs trailing, a powerful crouched landing on both feet. ROW 5 lizard's acidic spit: lifts snout, throat and mouth inflate green, jaws OPEN WIDE releasing a small bright green bead pointing RIGHT, recovers. Make each anticipation and attack silhouette genuinely different, attacks easy to identify at 80 pixels tall. No words, no numbers, no captions, no inset portraits, no grid lines, no scenery, no shadows and no painted trails, allow ample cell padding. Concise authentic 16-bit game art.

Arcade knockdown animation sheet for a scrolling beat-em-up. FOUR rows, FOUR columns, sixteen isolated sprites on truly transparent background. The four rows MUST respectively match the four characters left-to-right in the reference, including their squat proportions, colours, and headgear. All initially facing RIGHT. Row 1 purple-knit-cap dock thug, red vest, grey trousers. Row 2 yellow-hardhat bearded foreman, teal mechanic uniform. Row 3 helmeted airborne soldier with red scarf and black jetpack. Row 4 olive-uniform metal robot with red visor, helmet, silver mechanical joints. Each row shows 4 consecutive DIFFERENT full body poses: (1) recoils, knees buckle, arms wide, (2) falls backwards diagonally toward the LEFT and hips lower, (3) hits the street on backside with elbows down and legs bent to the RIGHT, (4) lies fully horizontal on his side/back, head left, boot soles right, body relaxed. The last two poses MUST be low to the ground and visibly different from upright art. Jetpack is OFF, no flames. Thugs and soldiers have EMPTY HANDS, their weapons are separate game objects. Bodies stay the same actual size as they rotate, keep heads consistently sized. Rich clean hand-shaded classic arcade pixel art, dark outlines; no blood, no scenery or ground shadow, no letters, no effects, no separators. Plenty of space so each full sprite stays in its own cell.
